driver-layers.title: The layers, one of them yours
driver-layers.alt: Layer diagram: the application calls the hardware-agnostic XMPL100 core, which uses the CRTP SPI port contract, which calls the platform port you write, which drives the chip.
driver-layers.description: From top to bottom. Your application calls one object, whose public calls are listed from the umbrella header in inc/. Each call becomes register transfers through the port contract (the CRTP base in inc/*_interface.hpp), which forwards them to the port class you write. A library without a port contract has only the first two layers.
